problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 9 delivery routes across 9 distribution hubs.

Each delivery route consists of a sequence of hub stops represented as pairs (Hub, Handling time),
where each pair specifies the hub where the package must be processed and the amount of time required for handling.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the hub stops must be visited.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (H6, 1) → (H2, 7) → (H3, 4) → (H5, 7) → (H8, 10) → (H7, 8) → (H1, 5) → (H4, 1) → (H9, 3)
* R2 requires the sequence: (H8, 10) → (H2, 3) → (H6, 4) → (H1, 9) → (H7, 2) → (H5, 1) → (H4, 1) → (H9, 7) → (H3, 7)
* R3 requires the sequence: (H5, 9) → (H3, 6) → (H7, 10) → (H4, 4) → (H1, 1) → (H8, 7) → (H6, 8) → (H2, 9) → (H9, 1)
* R4 requires the sequence: (H4, 2) → (H6, 5) → (H9, 6) → (H8, 6) → (H2, 5) → (H5, 3) → (H1, 3) → (H3, 10) → (H7, 7)
* R5 requires the sequence: (H5, 7) → (H1, 7) → (H4, 3) → (H8, 9) → (H9, 8) → (H7, 10) → (H6, 6) → (H2, 1) → (H3, 10)
* R6 requires the sequence: (H9, 3) → (H4, 3) → (H2, 5) → (H5, 1) → (H8, 6) → (H6, 2) → (H1, 3) → (H3, 10) → (H7, 9)
* R7 requires the sequence: (H3, 10) → (H7, 5) → (H9, 7) → (H1, 1) → (H8, 4) → (H2, 10) → (H6, 5) → (H5, 4) → (H4, 6)
* R8 requires the sequence: (H2, 5) → (H5, 4) → (H4, 6) → (H3, 4) → (H6, 4) → (H1, 4) → (H9, 4) → (H7, 7) → (H8, 2)
* R9 requires the sequence: (H9, 2) → (H5, 5) → (H6, 4) → (H2, 9) → (H3, 5) → (H4, 2) → (H1, 2) → (H8, 9) → (H7, 7)

Each hub stop must be processed continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each distribution hub can only handle one package at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing schedule of all hub stops across the distribution network
so that the total completion time of all delivery routes is minimized.
